title: Zesty Crispy Korean Yellow Masarepa Bokkeum
description: A peppery and crispy Korean dish featuring yellow masarepa, shio-koji-cure, and plant-based friendly ingredients, originating from the Gangwon region.
instructions: Cook the pre-cooked yellow masarepa according to package instructions and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, blend shio-koji, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, Gochujang, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Let the tofu marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat and add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil.
Add the marinated tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown and crispy.
Add the cooked yellow masarepa to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped scallions and minced garlic to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional minute.
Season with additional soy sauce or Gochujang if needed.
Serve the Zesty Crispy Korean Yellow Masarepa Bokkeum hot and enjoy.
